upstream_pin.version_boundary: Play Framework 3.0.12 Scala routes-file scope only; Play 2.9.x, Java routes, SIRD-only routers and later 3.0.x are excluded

constructs.invariant: *name spans slash-separated segments and has different decoding/reverse-routing semantics from :name.
$id<[0-9]+> narrows accepted paths; source text alone is not a validated request oracle.
+ nocsrf changes CSRF handling but route presence alone does not prove response or security behavior.
A -> /api mount delegates to api.MyRouter; child paths cannot be projected from the parent routes file alone.

runtime_oracle_plan.toolchain: Pin an approved JDK, Scala, sbt and resolved Play 3.0.12 plugin/dependency graph on an isolated T20 runner before compilation
steps: Verify annotated 3.0.12 tag object, peeled commit and six exact upstream source hashes; capture plugin artifact and resolved dependency checksums.

Materialize each authored fixture as an independent Play Scala app with complete controllers, child router and configuration as needed; compile conf/routes with the Play routes compiler and retain generated router and diagnostics.
Compare generated route metadata and source expectations for normal GET/POST, wildcard, regex, modifier and mounted-router cases; do not infer child routes from a parent mount.

Use Play test helpers with FakeRequest and route(app, ...) for matching and nonmatching methods, one/multiple wildcard segments, regex valid/invalid IDs, CSRF enabled/disabled requests and child-router registration; record method, path, status, body, filters and generated handler.
Obtain T08 Scala language-profile review, T16 independent read and T19 mutation review before any extractor or support claim.
Evaluate HTTP leaf/bridge and packed-artifact behavior only after T00 authorizes composition; catalog admission and this plan do not remove the T08-05 block.

limits: These routes and Scala files are hand-authored planning fixtures, not copied upstream source, compiled Play routes or executed requests.
Play 3.0.12 is pinned for planning, but a complete sbt dependency lock, JDK/Scala toolchain and runtime oracle are not present.
The T13 catalog admission remains DEFER_UNTIL_PROFILE_REVIEW and is not support; T08-05 HTTP composition remains BLOCKED.
No Scala parser, Play routes extractor, adapter, registry, CLI path or shared-schema projection is added.
No independent attestation, certification, promotion or release gate is exercised here.
